messages:
leo_sales: FYI - Nimbus Robotics wants a custom package: 200M embedding units + inference credits. Asking for 40% off list + net-45 and $30k implementation credit. Pitch is Monday, need fast decision.
ada_csm: They've been in PoC for 6 weeks. Results look good; expected ramp to 40-50k/mo by Q3. They're willing to do a customer story if we give a logo discount.
hannah_finance: 40% is steep. What's the committed ARR if we went with that? Also need payment signal (prepay vs invoiced), and warranty on churn.
leo_sales: Customer commitment ask = 12mo, baseline $480k ARR (pre-discount). Their ask 40% -> $288k. They prefer invoice net-45; could consider prepay if we reduce discount to 30%.
dev_revops: Noted. Minimum gross margin constraint: can't go below 30% blended. If we do 35% discount we need 6-mo prepay or signed SLA on ramp. Also we should add a usage overage cliff: if usage > 125% of forecast, price re-negotiation.
nina_legal: Need to review data handling: robotics telemetry may include PII? Also they asked for exclusive field support in EMEA. We must avoid exclusivity. Require SOC2 + DPA signed. No net-45 without confirmation of creditworthiness and AR team signoff.
leo_sales: They offered trade: one-year commit + case study + reference call for 25% discount. They're pushing hard on cashflow constraints.
hannah_finance: Counter proposal: Approve up to 30% discount + $20k implementation credit if customer signs 12mo and prepays first 90 days. If they want net-45 instead of prepay, discount limited to 20% and require corporate guarantee.
ada_csm: They can probably prepay first quarter if we give them early-bird invoicing terms. I'll push for the 30% route.
dev_revops: I'll open a Deal Desk ticket and draft the commercial memo. Key items: customer, baseline ARR, proposed discount tiers (20/30/35), prepay requirement for higher tiers, $ cap on onboarding credits, overage re-eval clause at month 4, and SLA extension clause.
billingbot: dealdesk-create: Ticket created DD-2026-219. Link: https://redwood.internal/deal/DD-2026-219
nina_legal: Add to memo: DPA, SOC2 within 10 business days, no exclusivity, IP carveouts minimal, and standard indemnity. Also need CSQ completed.
hannah_finance: Conditional approval: 30% with $20k credit if 12mo + prepay-90 OR 20% + $20k credit + corporate guarantee for net-45. Cap onboarding SLA penalty exposure at $7,500 if integration delayed up to 45 days.
leo_sales: Thanks. I'll present both options Monday and try to secure the prepay. If they balk, we'll push the corporate guarantee.
ada_csm: LOI ready to be updated with chosen option. I'll hold until Sales confirms which variant they accept.
dev_revops: Memo attached to DD-2026-219. Please review and approve in thread. I'll route to SalesOps for final clause insertion once Finance signs.
hannah_finance: Reviewing memo now. If Legal signs off on DPA and CSQ, Finance can give final sign-off by EOD tomorrow.
leo_sales: Great. Will update after pitch. :rocket:
